_comment: Prices are CONFIGURATION. Every entry below was read from the provider's official pricing page on the date in 'asOf' (see docs/ai-verification.md). Units: integer micro-USD per 1,000,000 tokens (0.10 USD per million tokens = 100000). They assume STANDARD synchronous requests on the default (global) routing with no prompt caching, no batch/flex/priority tier and no regional/data-residency uplift; those change the price and are NOT modelled. A model with no entry has an UNKNOWN cost (recorded as unknown, never zero). Re-verify before relying on these: provider prices change.

prices.appliesTo: Claude API, global routing, standard (non-batch), no prompt caching. Prompts over 100,000 tokens use the higher long-context rate. US-only inference_geo adds 1.1x (not modelled).
